silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the hidden truck capacity limit and omitted any truck capacity constraint from the READY_TO_MODEL formulation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot is P2, so no unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent clarified major modeling assumptions such as cost uniformity, supply/demand slack, and integrality, but missed the P2 truck-capacity detail. Since only a P2 hidden slot remained unresolved, its stopping behavior was appropriate.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.
